author: Bay State News
title: Mintz receives broad recognition in Legal 500 United States 2026 Guide
text:
Mintz has earned top rankings in the Legal 500 United States 2026 Guide, according to a June 10 announcement. The firm is recognized across 20 practice categories and has 82 individual attorneys listed, including seven as “Leading Partner,” one as “Leading Associate,” and five with the designation of “Next Generation Partner.”
The recognized practices include advice to insurers, capital markets equity offerings, construction (including litigation), corporate investigations and white-collar criminal defense, cyber law, e-discovery, employee benefits and executive compensation transactional work, general commercial disputes for mid-market clients, immigration, life sciences, middle-market mergers and acquisitions, patent litigation and prosecution (including re-examination), project finance, real estate for the middle market sector, municipal restructuring at Tier 1 level—including bankruptcy—securities litigation defense work, service providers legal support roles, telecoms and broadcast regulatory issues, venture capital and emerging companies counseling, as well as workplace and employment counseling.
Individual attorneys highlighted span multiple offices. For example: Marc Abrams was recognized for advice to insurers; Tony Starr was named a Leading Partner in construction; Siegmund Gutman received Leading Partner status in life sciences; Joseph Ronca was designated Next Generation Partner for M&A; Daniel Guggenheim is a Leading Partner in real estate; Ian Hammel is a Leading Partner in restructuring; Hope Foster received recognition as a Leading Partner among service providers; Angela Kung is noted as Leading Partner in telecoms regulation.
Legal 500 has been publishing its rankings for over three decades. The guide covers legal services providers across more than 150 jurisdictions. Its research draws on feedback from over 300,000 corporate counsel worldwide along with submissions from law firms themselves and interviews with leading private practice lawyers. A dedicated team of researchers with extensive experience conducts this process.
The full Legal 500 rankings are available online.
summary: Mintz has earned top rankings in the Legal 500 United States 2026 Guide, according to a June 10 announcement.
